mapper.insert: INSERT INTO serial_release_intent(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,serial_id,sku_id,transfer_id,release_ref,from_epoch,target_warehouse_id,context_hash,next_attempt_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.e},#{row.w},#{row.serial},#{row.sku},#{row.transfer},#{row.ref},#{row.epoch},#{row.target},#{row.hash},#{row.now},#{row.now},#{row.now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,serial_id,sku_id,release_ref,transfer_id,from_epoch,target_warehouse_id,context_hash,state,claim_epoch,attempts FROM serial_release_intent WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE serial_release_intent SET state='RUNNING',claim_epoch=claim_epoch+1,attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=#{until},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND attempts<12

UPDATE serial_release_intent SET state=#{state},last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{next},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND state IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')

UPDATE serial_release_intent SET state='PENDING',attempts=0,claim_epoch=claim_epoch+1,next_attempt_at=#{now},last_error=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND state='ISOLATED'
